# theme-classic

<NpmBadge package="@vuepress/theme-classic" />

## Usage

Install `@vuepress/theme-classic` :

```bash
npm install @vuepress/theme-classic@next
```

```ts title=".vuepress/config.ts"
import { themeClassic } from '@vuepress/theme-classic'

export default {
  theme: themeClassic({
    // set theme config here
  }),
}
```
